title: Find your main water shutoff valve, Gwinnett County
text: Most Gwinnett homes have the main shutoff where the water line enters the house. Find yours before a freeze. If you have active water damage, here's how to reach a local provider. We may be paid a fee for calls we route to independent providers. #FreezePrep #GwinnettCounty
alt: A hand turning a red-handled water shutoff valve in a basement. Text on image: Find your main shutoff.
